## 类型

- [ ] feat (新功能)
- [ ] fix (bug 修复)
- [ ] refactor (重构)
- [ ] docs (文档)
- [ ] test (测试)
- [ ] chore (杂项)

## 验收

- [ ] ruff format + ruff check 通过
- [ ] pytest 通过 (含新写测试)
- [ ] coverage ≥ 80%
- [ ] bandit 0 Medium+
- [ ] (前端) pnpm typecheck + lint 通过
- [ ] PR description 引用了 backlog task ID
- [ ] 不含明文密码 / API key / 客户 IP
